english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that something is caused by A.
Use this when stating that an outcome arises from a particular fact, circumstance, or action.

examples.english: This fire may stem from a short circuit.
examples.traditional: 呢場火災可能係由電線短路引起嘅。
examples.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 fo2 zoi1 ho2 nang4 hai6 jau4 din6 sin3 dyun2 lou6 jan5 hei2 ge3

examples.english: This power outage did result from a thunderstorm.
examples.traditional: 呢次停電係由雷暴引起嘅。
examples.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ting4 din6 hai6 jau4 leoi4 bou6 jan5 hei2 ge3
